source: Project task profiles for Meta-World v3 CW10 under the cw10_v1 reward protocol.

hammer-v3.official_description: Hammer a screw into a wall with a hammer.
hammer-v3.interaction_structure: tool acquisition followed by aligned impact

push-wall-v3.official_description: Push a puck to a goal while bypassing a wall.

faucet-close-v3.official_description: Rotate a faucet clockwise to turn it off.
faucet-close-v3.interaction_structure: direct handle engagement and constrained rotation

push-back-v3.official_description: Pull a puck to a goal.
push-back-v3.interaction_structure: rear-side alignment and direct sustained planar motion

stick-pull-v3.official_description: Grasp a stick and use it to pull a box.
stick-pull-v3.interaction_structure: grasp and lift a tool, align it to a handle, then preserve tool-object contact while indirectly moving the box
stick-pull-v3.reward_protocol_note: v3 environment with the project v1-compatible reward observation alignment

push-v3.official_description: Push a puck to a goal.

shelf-place-v3.official_description: Pick up a puck and place it on a shelf.
shelf-place-v3.interaction_structure: direct grasp, lift, transport, alignment, and release

window-close-v3.interaction_structure: direct handle engagement and constrained sliding

peg-unplug-side-v3.interaction_structure: direct grasp and constrained lateral extraction
